purpose: Freeze user-facing fallback and exception behavior for the validated Stage 5-5-3 Hero header/basic-information output without changing source semantics.

stateTaxonomy.NONE: The source semantics explicitly confirm that the thing does not exist. User-facing UI may display an explicit absence label when useful.
stateTaxonomy.UNENCODED: The source omits the specific metadata. This is not equivalent to NONE and must not be converted into an inferred category.
stateTaxonomy.DEFERRED_LOCALIZATION: Authoritative source text exists but Korean presentation text has not yet been supplied. This is not missing source data.
stateTaxonomy.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The value belongs to another accepted stage or later composition layer and must not be synthesized here.

identity.rule: Canonical Hero names are always displayed directly; no fallback synthesis is required.

rarity.rule: Display only the validated base rarity N/R/SR/SSR/LLR in Stage 5-5-4.
rarity.spRule: SP is OUT_OF_SCOPE and must not overwrite baseLabel.
rarity.soloLimitedSsrRule: SSR(1-person-limited) is OUT_OF_SCOPE banner/summon presentation metadata and must not be inferred from base rarity.

factions.nullMeaning: nameKr=null means DEFERRED_LOCALIZATION, not missing faction data.
factions.rule: Always keep all validated faction memberships. Until Korean labels are supplied, source Chinese labels may be used as the text fallback/tooltip while the icon remains authoritative.

NAMED.rule: Preserve the source actor spelling until the user supplies Korean localization.

NONE.rule: Never expose the raw ■■■■ marker to the user. NONE is a confirmed absence state, not an unresolved actor.

cv.rule: Do not collapse NAMED-with-null-nameKr into NONE or unknown.

origin.categoryUse: origin.category is a filter/grouping value and does not replace the work-title label.
origin.rule: Display the validated Chinese work title until an accepted Korean title dictionary is supplied.

navigation.whenTotalEquals1: Hide previous/next controls and hide the current/total counter.
navigation.whenTotalGreaterThan1: Show previous/next controls and show current/total using the current Stage 5-5-4 gallery sequence.

spIllustration.designRequirement: The final page may include SP illustration in the same gallery when SP exists.
spIllustration.rule: Do not invent an SP gallery insertion position in Stage 5-5-4. Preserve the base + regular-skin order until Stage 5-4 data is composed.

artworkGallery.assetRule: Source asset paths are authoritative locators, not browser URLs. Export/web-delivery failure is an asset-pipeline concern and must not be rewritten as source-data absence.

ENCODED.rule: Show the validated Korean acquisition category above the gallery counter when the current gallery item is a regular skin.

UNENCODED.rule: Do not show '미기록', '이벤트', '무료', or any other guessed acquisition route as production user-facing acquisition text. The acquisition line is omitted for that skin until a verified supplemental dictionary exists.

skinAcquisition.baseArtworkRule: Base artwork has no skin-acquisition label.
skinAcquisition.rule: Acquisition text is item-specific presentation metadata, not a Hero-level label.

noRegularSkins.display: Show only the base artwork. Hide gallery navigation/counter and do not render an empty skin card or '스킨 없음' banner in the header.
noRegularSkins.rule: An empty skins array is a confirmed no-regular-skin state under the current ConfigData snapshot, not an error.

localization.fallbackRule: Use the validated source text as the temporary display fallback; never auto-translate it into a new stored Korean source value.
localization.storageRule: Fallback rendering must not mutate Stage 5-5-3 output or backfill nameKr.

prohibitions: Do not display ■■■■ as a voice-actor name.
Do not treat null Korean localization as missing source data.
Do not label every UNENCODED skin as event/free/shop or any other inferred acquisition type.
Do not show meaningless 1/1 gallery controls when a Hero has no regular skins.
Do not reorder skins while composing the gallery.
Do not insert SP illustration into the gallery until Stage 5-4 composition defines that behavior.
Do not rewrite source asset paths into guessed web URLs.
Do not promote SSR to SSR(1-person-limited) in this stage.
completionRule: Stage 5-5-4 is complete when every current Stage 5-5-3 record maps deterministically to these display states with no source marker leakage, no fabricated acquisition text, no localization synthesis, and no gallery-order changes.
nextAction: Validate these policies across all 267 Heroes and freeze a Stage 5-5-4 validation artifact.
